changeSet.author: nexus-tk070.p5a
changeSet.comment: RDR-194 D4: nexus.topics is the "surrogate PK that other FKs reference" case. The BIGSERIAL PK stays (four FK columns depend on it); this changeset adds UNIQUE (tenant_id, id) so the four FKs below can be repointed onto a tenant-scoped composite. Unconditional -- ships regardless of the repoint's own precondition (cloud-count-5).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.topics ADD CONSTRAINT topics_tenant_id_unique UNIQUE (tenant_id, id);
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE nexus.topics DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS topics_tenant_id_unique;

changeSet.author: nexus-tk070.p5a
changeSet.comment: RDR-194 D4: repoint topics_parent_fk (self-referential: topics.parent_id -> topics.id) onto the tenant-scoped composite UNIQUE added in taxonomy-014-1. Catalog-029 three-step shape (DROP old -> ADD new NOT VALID -> anti-join -> VALIDATE), all in this one changeset (EXPECT_NEW_CHANGESETS=5 forces one changeset per FK, not catalog-029's own 3-changeset split -- see file header). Anti-join is fail-loud on a nonzero cross-tenant population (D4): a cross-tenant parent reference is corruption, not a population to remediate silently. RLS toggle-wrapped (nexus.topics is FORCE RLS and self-joined by the anti-join).

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.topics DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_topics_parent_tenant; ALTER TABLE nexus.topics ADD CONSTRAINT topics_parent_fk FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES nexus.topics(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

changeSet.author: nexus-tk070.p5a
changeSet.comment: RDR-194 D4: repoint topic_assignments_topic_id_fkey onto the tenant-scoped composite. Same catalog-029 three-step shape, fail-loud anti-join, as taxonomy-014-2. RLS toggle-wrapped on BOTH topic_assignments (target) and topics (referenced) -- nexus-1wjmq both-tables shape.

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.topic_assignments DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_topic_assignments_topic_tenant; ALTER TABLE nexus.topic_assignments ADD CONSTRAINT topic_assignments_topic_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (topic_id) REFERENCES nexus.topics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.topic_links DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_topic_links_from_topic_tenant; ALTER TABLE nexus.topic_links ADD CONSTRAINT topic_links_from_topic_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (from_topic_id) REFERENCES nexus.topics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.topic_links DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_topic_links_to_topic_tenant; ALTER TABLE nexus.topic_links ADD CONSTRAINT topic_links_to_topic_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (to_topic_id) REFERENCES nexus.topics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
